$comment: Run-only tsconfig for scripts/admin-agent-eval.ts (plan 7.2). Modelled on tsconfig.example.json, not on tsconfig.audit.json: `@format-pack` and `@pack-extensions` are pinned to the public EXAMPLE pack (tsx never reads FORMAT_PACK, and the audit config lists the private pack first), so a maintainer checkout cannot load the private pack into a run that sends data to a model API. `server-only` and `next/cache` map to the no-op stubs the tests use, and `@/auth` maps to a stub with no sign-in (the plan stage answers its reads from the fixture world, so no guard runs). The root tsconfig is untouched; `tsc --noEmit` does not use this file. A test (`eval/__tests__/eval-static.test.ts`) fails when this file lets a private path in.
